findings.failure_scenario: Parsing any Konami SNES sequence containing a GAIN event (e.g., status 0x7B) with newGAINAmount = 15: baseline printed "GAIN: 15 ($3F)"; the new fmt::format("GAIN: {} (${:02X})", newGAINAmount, newGAIN) prints "GAIN: \x0F ($3F)" because fmt >= 8 formats uint8_t/char types as characters by default (the same diff adds {:d} in other files precisely to avoid this), so the UI shows an unprintable byte instead of the value.
findings.summary: EVENT_GAIN description formats uint8_t newGAINAmount with a bare {} so the decimal value is replaced by a raw control character in the event view

findings.failure_scenario: A tempo fade event with fadeSpeed = 64: baseline printed "BPM: 120  Fade Length: 64"; the new fmt::format("BPM: {}  Fade Length: {}", ..., fadeSpeed) prints "BPM: 120  Fade Length: @" (character 0x40) in the UI event description.
findings.summary: EVENT_TEMPO_FADE description formats uint8_t fadeSpeed with a bare {} replacing the old (int) cast, so the fade length renders as a raw character

findings.failure_scenario: An undocumented event with arg1 = 0x41 at lines 189/197/206/216: baseline built "Event: 0xXX  Arg1: 65" via (int) arg1; the new describeUnknownEvent(statusByte, arg1) routes through logEvent's ostringstream fold ("Arg" << n << ": " << args) with no cast, so the UI shows "Arg1: A" (raw char) instead of the decimal value, making unknown-event analysis misleading.
findings.summary: EVENT_UNKNOWN1-4 now pass raw uint8_t arg values to describeUnknownEvent, whose ostream fold prints them as characters instead of the old (int) decimal output

findings.failure_scenario: An undocumented Prism event with arg1 = 0x31 at lines 277/285/294/304: baseline printed "Event: 0xXX  Arg1: 49"; the new describeUnknownEvent(statusByte, arg1) call emits "Arg1: 1" (raw char 0x31) through logEvent's uncast ostream fold, corrupting the event description shown to users.
findings.summary: EVENT_UNKNOWN1-4 pass raw uint8_t arg values to describeUnknownEvent, printing them as characters where the baseline printed (int) decimals
